obfuscation_indicators: significant use of estimates and assumptions
high degree of judgment and complexity
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and well quantified, with clear year-over-year metrics and explanations of major drivers. Risk remains elevated due to nonperforming assets, large provisions, credit deterioration in several large covered credits, and reliance on complex FDIC loss-share and fair-value estimates. The tone is cautiously positive because the company returned to profitability and reported improving loan demand and declining nonperforming assets.
